headline: Callahan's Gate Shifts as Weathered Expanse Quiets
war_summary: The wires put Dead Lands to the fore since the last edition with three changes in two hours and five on the day about Callahan's Gate, last reported at 08:25, amid 3,564 Colonial and 6,915 Warden casualties with hourly rates cooling. The Weathered Expanse, lately busiest, has gone quiet with none in two hours after six in six and twenty-seven on the day about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now standing four Warden to five Colonial. Stonecradle counts none in two hours after three in six and eleven on the day about World's End, The Dais and The Heir's Knife, though two-hour losses of 383 Colonial and 600 Warden are accelerating. Linn Mercy shows none in two after three in six and thirteen on the day about Lathair and Rotdust, Stlican Shelf none in two after two in six and eight on the day about Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost, and Mooring County none in two and six after eleven on the day about The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk. Nevish Line reports 5,966 Colonial and 3,732 Warden casualties with 1,154 new enlistments but no flips.
